items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: talk to Uncle Lionel, Maro’s husband, who could advise her about what courses to take and what university.

ctx.x: It was time to split. He was getting very possessive, and she felt that a change was necessary. She decided also she wants to major in psychology, and they didn’t have a psychology department that was worth it at Western Washington State. So she decided to come home at the end of the first semester. On the way, she found she could get an air ticket to San Francisco and talk to Uncle Lionel, Maro’s husband, who could advise her about what courses to take and what university.
